description: Na₂GeF₆ is beta Vanadium nitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P̅3m1 space group. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent GeF₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one GeF₆ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.39 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to six F atoms to form GeF₆ octahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. All Ge-F bond lengths are 1.84 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form GeF₆ octahedra that share edges with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. All Ge-F bond lengths are 1.84 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ge atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ge atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Ge atom.
